I have grown rice on this plot since I was a young girl, and my mother never used chemical fertilizer, so I will not either. I will spread goat and chicken manure on the soil before planting because that is what I know, and I will sow the rice seed I kept from last harvest. My children and I will do all the work — planting, weeding, and harvesting — because I do not have cash to pay workers, and if weeds come we will pull them by hand.
